subject: SLO alignment & temporary night rotation exception request — ClearRiver Health
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clearriverhealth.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.ellis@clearriverhealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary P2 response alignment overnight during migration

Hi Sofia,

We have a planned data migration on Dec 20–22 that will generate a spike of non-actionable alerts overnight (US Pacific). Our internal on-call team will be significantly reduced those nights due to travel and a board meeting.

To avoid noisy P2 escalations while the engineering team validates the migration, can Redwood temporarily align our P2 response window from 8am–6pm PT to 24-hour on-call only for P1s, and move P2 to first-business-hour response (i.e., 8am PT next business day) for Dec 20–24? We understand this is an SLO carveout and are happy to accept a short SLA exception with a mitigation plan.

We'd like to formalize this quickly so our procurement team can sign off. Can you confirm the process and who needs to approve?

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Director of Platform Ops
ClearRiver Health
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: anika.rao@clearriverhealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response alignment overnight during migration

Hi Anika — thanks for the heads up and the proposed window. We can make a temporary exception, but we need to (1) align on exact hours and scope, (2) confirm on-call coverage from our side for P1s, and (3) get approval from our CS leadership for the SLA carveout.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll draft a short exception addendum that specifies dates (Dec 20 00:00 PT through Dec 24 23:59 PT), affected SLOs (P2 next-business-hour response only), and acceptance criteria.
- Ben from Sales will coordinate procurement language and any credits.
- Lauren — can you confirm we have on-call capacity for P1 coverage overnight those nights and whether we need to adjust rotations?

If OK, I can loop in our legal and CS and send a formal addendum by Thursday.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response alignment overnight during migration

Sofia/Ben — we can cover P1s overnight but need to make two short adjustments to keep latency and on-call fatigue reasonable:

1) Modify the night rotation for Dec 20–24: split nights into two 6-hour windows (00:00–06:00 PT and 06:00–12:00 PT) rather than one 12-hour shift to avoid cognitive load.
2) Assign a dedicated escalation owner (Marissa) who will handle immediate triage and escalate to the senior on-call if a P1 is not acknowledged within 15 minutes.

I attached a brief runbook and a proposed rotation PDF (CRH-night-rotation-proposal.pdf, runbook-p1-p2-bridge.txt). If approved, I need the names of any external vendor contacts who may be calling in so we can whitelist numbers.

Also, Ben — we should confirm whether the procurement team expects an SLA credit for P2 handling; if so, let's draft the language now.

-Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Support Ops
Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: anika.rao@clearriverhealth.com, tom.ellis@clearriverhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response alignment overnight during migration

Thanks — flagged this with procurement. Quick notes:
- Procurement is OK with a 5% one-time service credit if Redwood agrees to the temporary P2 carveout. They asked that the exception be documented and limited to Dec 20–24 inclusive.
- Legal asked that we include a clause that the carveout does not apply to incidents caused by Redwood platform outages (i.e., if the P2 is due to our service degradation, Redwood remains responsible).

Anika/Tom — does ClearRiver accept the 5% credit and the carveout terms as described? If yes, Sofia and I will get the addendum drafted and loop Legal.

-ben

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@clearriverhealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, tom.ellis@clearriverhealth.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response alignment overnight during migration

Ben/Sofia/Lauren — confirmed. ClearRiver accepts the 5% one-time credit and the carveout limitation excluding Redwood-caused outages. We'll also share the vendor contact list by EOD Dec 17 for whitelisting. Please send the addendum and the updated runbook so our procurement and compliance teams can sign.

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Appreciate the split-night rotation suggestion — that should help reduce handoff noise.

Best,
Anika Rao
Director of Platform Ops
ClearRiver Health
